gloss: to put together; to summarize; to settle

definitions.explanation: To gather scattered things into one place or group.
To organize information into a coherent summary or document.

definitions.gloss: to settle; to bring to a conclusion
definitions.explanation: To bring negotiations, arguments, or affairs to a resolution.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}を{纏|まと}めて{出|で}かけた。
examples.english: I gathered my things and went out.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{内容|ないよう}を{纏|まと}めてください。
{話|はなし}を{纏|まと}めるのに{時間|じかん}がかかった。
examples.english: It took time to settle the matter.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}を{一|ひと}つに{纏|まと}めた。
{髪|かみ}を{纏|まと}めて{結|むす}んだ。
examples.english: I gathered my hair and tied it up.

examples.japanese: {ゴミ|ごみ}を{一|ひと}か{所|しょ}に{纏|まと}める。
examples.english: Gather the trash in one place.

examples.japanese: {情報|じょうほう}を{纏|まと}めてレポートにした。
examples.english: I compiled the information into a report.

examples.japanese: {考|かんが}えを{纏|まと}めてから{話|はな}す。
examples.english: I'll organize my thoughts before speaking.

examples.japanese: {調査|ちょうさ}{結果|けっか}を{纏|まと}める。
{要点|ようてん}を{纏|まと}めて{説明|せつめい}する。
examples.english: Summarize the key points and explain.

examples.japanese: {交渉|こうしょう}を{纏|まと}めることができた。
examples.english: I was able to conclude the negotiations.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}を{纏|まと}める{責任|せきにん}がある。
examples.english: I have the responsibility to close the contract.

examples.japanese: {グループ|ぐるーぷ}を{纏|まと}めるのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's difficult to bring the group together.

examples.japanese: {意見|いけん}を{纏|まと}めて{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: I consolidated the opinions and announced them.

examples.japanese: {まとめ買|が}いでお{得|とく}になる。
examples.english: You save money by buying in bulk.

notes:
{纏|まと}める is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) used for organizing, summarizing, and concluding.

INTRANSITIVE PAIR: {纏|まと}まる (to be settled, to come together)
- {纏|まと}める: I summarize the report.
- {纏|まと}まる: The plan comes together.

ASPECT (ている):
{纏|まと}めている indicates the organizing/summarizing process is ongoing.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [things]を{纏|まと}める — to put [things] together
- [information]を{纏|まと}める — to summarize [information]
- [negotiation]を{纏|まと}める — to conclude [negotiation]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {髪|かみ}を{纏|まと}める (put up one's hair)
- {考|かんが}えを{纏|まと}める (organize one's thoughts)
- {まとめ買|が}い (buying in bulk)
- {まとめ} (summary - noun)

OFTEN IN HIRAGANA:
Due to the kanji's complexity, this verb is very often written as まとめる.

RELATED:
{まとめ}サイト (summary site, aggregation site)
